claims.evidence: No photo shows import sticker, UK grey-market marks, or cosmetic 'neat' condition details like screen/body wear
Photo 0 and Photo 2 show body text 'Canon EOS 800' matching model
Photo 0 shows lens barrel text 'Canon EF-S 18-55mm'

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or have functional sensor/shutter
risks.proof: Video clip of camera powering on, displaying live view, and shutter firing

risks.risk: LCD screen shown closed/folded, unknown if it works or is cracked
risks.proof: Photo of LCD screen open and displaying image/menu

risks.risk: Lens cap on in all photos, internal glass condition (fungus, scratches, haze) unknown
risks.proof: Photo of lens with cap off, through the barrel against light
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens with possible optical defects

risks.risk: Shutter count/usage history unknown, affects remaining mechanical life
risks.proof: Photo of shutter count from camera menu or EXIF data screenshot

risks.risk: No battery, charger, memory card, or strap confirmed in listing
risks.proof: Photo of full accessory bundle laid out
risks.if_unproven: priced as body+lens only, no accessories

risks.risk: Hidden body damage (dents, cracks) where hand grips the camera
risks.proof: Photo of all sides of camera body fully visible without hand covering

risks.risk: 'UK used' origin unverifiable, could affect warranty/authenticity expectations
risks.proof: Photo of UK import sticker, box, or original UK receipt
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified origin, no premium for UK-used claim

proof_requests: Photo of open LCD screen showing menu or live image
Photo of lens with cap removed, checked against light for fungus/scratches
Screenshot or photo of shutter count from camera settings
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, card, strap)
Full 360-degree photos of camera body without hand obstruction
Any proof of UK origin (sticker, box, receipt)
response.reason: Witness clearly identified the item as a Canon EOS 800D with 18-55mm lens, so it can be priced at worst case pending proof of functionality, condition, and accessories.
